title: The Living Measure
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: An original work centred on the idea of a living measure. Its title offers an entry point into questions of proportion, meaning and the relationship between human life and a wider order.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF).
